The outfit sits on her skin with soft highlights, her skin tone running naturally everywhere else. Background: a hexagonal room with floor-to-ceiling mirrors on all six walls and a white mirrored floor, lit by bright soft white light with gentle shadows, the whole floor clearly visible and in focus. Every mirror shows the true self of the same woman instead of the woman as she stands: her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles turned into mirror-polished liquid chrome, a seamless liquid-metal shell that bends the whole room into sharp warped reflections over every curve, her face, ears and neck still living skin, in the identical pose and the identical towering heels, the ring of true-self reflections receding in six directions like a kaleidoscope. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, the reflections being part of that same photograph, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
